summary: Passage Bio (PASG) filed an 8-K regarding its entry into a merger agreement to acquire Remix Therapeutics via a stock-for-stock merger. At closing, Remix convertible notes and preferred stock will convert into Remix common stock, which will then be exchanged for Passage Bio common shares. Remix stock options will be assumed. The filing does not disclose the exchange ratio, implied value, premium, board recommendation, advisor names, or regulatory timeline. A concurrent financing is noted. The deal structure resembles a reverse merger where Remix becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. Watch for stockholder approvals and regulatory clearance to assess risk-arb spread.
